rationale: Block 4 covers the SPIKES protocol and valid informed consent elements — a MultiChoice testing application of SPIKES steps reinforces this core counselling framework
Block 3 covers clinical indications for prognosis counselling — a TrueFalse tests understanding of when prognosis counselling is legally and clinically obligatory
Block 7 covers reading patient cues and adapting the consultation — a MultiChoice testing recognition of cues that signal the consultation needs re-framing reinforces adaptive communication skills

Block 3 defines orthopaedic warning signals (osteomyelitis, septic arthritis, neurovascular injury, cauda equina) — MultiChoice tests recognition of which constellation of findings demands same-day referral
Block 4 explains why warning signals demand higher-centre resources — a TrueFalse tests understanding of why cauda equina syndrome is an absolute surgical emergency
Block 6 covers technique for convincing reluctant patients to accept referral — MultiChoice tests application of referral counselling strategy when a patient initially refuses
Block 3 covers amputation levels and how level selection affects rehabilitation — MultiChoice tests application of level-selection principles for below-knee vs above-knee amputation
Block 4 covers ideal stump characteristics — a TrueFalse tests understanding of the critical stump shape for a PTB prosthetic socket fit

Block 7 covers phantom limb pain counselling and neurobiological mechanism — MultiChoice tests analysis of the correct neurobiological explanation to give patients (maladaptive cortical reorganisation, not imagination)
